title: Can't Hurt Me: Master Your Mind and Defy the Odds
whyThisEdition: The standard English 2018 edition is the dominant canonical release for chapter-level study of the book.
Authorized Google Books metadata exposes the 2018 Lioncrest Publishing listing, while a later Google Books digital listing preserves the same 11-chapter order.
The only materially distinct visible variant in the source bundle is the clean edition, which was not requested and would affect wording more than chapter sequence.
No translation ambiguity applies because the run is locked to the standard English text family.
